verdict.rationale: LegalOS's USCIS fee calculator estimates Premium Processing fees for O-1, L-1, TN, EB-1A/EB-1C, and EB-2 NIW. That gives founders a cost figure and implicitly signals which classifications it covers, but nothing in the evidence explains how Form I-907 actually works. Missing for 10: explanation of which classifications qualify and why, stated fee amounts, what premium processing does and does not speed up (e.g., USCIS adjudication vs. downstream steps), and independent corroboration.
